name: Horse Train
body:
Cost 1,200 gp; hp 10
Traveler Capacity 6; Cargo Capacity 1
Limit 3; Consumption 6
Special Benefit +4 miles per day to caravan’s speed

DESCRIPTION

Adding horses to your caravan can help increase its speed, although at a significant increase to consumption.
